description: Baba Jaga, the oldest witch of Slavic tales, a hunched ancient crone with a long iron nose, wild grey hair, one leg of bare bone, a ragged dark brown shawl, leaning on a crooked staff topped with a small skull, a poisonous green curse swirling from her raised hand, glowing eyes, cackling, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the whole figure inside the picture
